pages.text: $(#c0283a)【Blood Pact】$()$(br2)Its hits put a Blood Pact on you for 60 s: every 8 s a local monster is called 8-16 blocks from you, up to 6 at once.$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Blood Oath Ring, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)A deep-red crystal with something like blood slowly flowing inside. Those who come close hear whispers.$()
